note: Vitamins: this column is retinol equivalents (RE), not retinol activity equivalents (RAE) -- they are different quantities that can differ by up to 2x for carotene-rich foods (RE historically used a 1:6 beta-carotene:retinol ratio; RAE uses 1:12). The aggregate RE figure alone cannot be converted to RAE without the underlying carotene breakdown, which this column does not carry, so it is dropped rather than stored under vitamin_a_rae. The canonical vocabulary has no separate RE key; retinol and carotene_beta are mapped individually below instead
